# Space and Tech Engineering LLP

> Made in India drone components

Space and Tech Engineering LLP is an Indian drone electronics company with offices in India. It designs and sells the Aazmuth and Exelr8 flight controllers, Skydrive AM32 ESCs and NAVSATE GPS modules for UAV and FPV builders.

We are a small team of hardware and firmware engineers making flight controllers, ESCs and GPS modules that Indian builders can actually get support for.

## Aazmuth flight controller
Category: Flight controllers
Status: Available
URL: https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/aazmuth-flight-controller.html

Aazmuth is our flagship flight controller for professional UAVs. It runs on an STM32 H7 (Cortex-M7, up to 480 MHz) and carries 3 IMUs and 2 barometers, each on its own isolated bus, so one noisy or failed sensor does not take down the flight. IMU boards plug in over 20-pin Aazmuth Bus connectors, which means you can swap or upgrade sensors without replacing the controller. Built for defence, industry, agriculture, survey, startups and universities.

Highlights:
- Triple IMU and dual barometer redundancy
- Isolated sensor buses, so vibration on one does not corrupt the others
- Modular IMU boards on the 20-pin Aazmuth Bus
- Public pinout, calibration and sensor-integration docs

Specifications:
- Microcontroller: STM32 H7, Cortex-M7
- Clock speed: Up to 480 MHz
- Memory: 2 MB flash, 1 MB RAM
- Redundancy: 3 IMUs, 2 barometers
- Size: 92 x 54 x 14.6 mm
- Weight: 63 g

Docs:
- Overview: https://spaceandtech-engineerings.gitbook.io/space-and-tech-engineerings-docs/flight-controller/aazmuth/overview
- Pinout: https://spaceandtech-engineerings.gitbook.io/space-and-tech-engineerings-docs/flight-controller/aazmuth/pinout-diagram
- Calibration: https://spaceandtech-engineerings.gitbook.io/space-and-tech-engineerings-docs/flight-controller/aazmuth/basic-configuration-and-calibration
- Sensors: https://spaceandtech-engineerings.gitbook.io/space-and-tech-engineerings-docs/flight-controller/aazmuth/sensor-integration-and-peripheral-hardware-connection
- Dimensions: https://spaceandtech-engineerings.gitbook.io/space-and-tech-engineerings-docs/flight-controller/aazmuth/dimensions

## Exelr8 FPV flight controller F7
Category: Flight controllers
Status: Available
URL: https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/exelr8-fpv-flight-controller-f7.html

Exelr8 is our F7 flight controller for FPV drones, made for tight, punchy racing and freestyle builds. It pairs with the Skydrive 55A AM32 4-in-1 ESC and the NAVSATE mini GPS to give you a complete Indian-designed FPV stack with local support.

Highlights:
- F7 processor
- Pairs with Skydrive 4-in-1 ESC and NAVSATE mini GPS
- Designed and supported in India

Specifications:
- Processor: F7
- Built for: FPV racing and freestyle

## Skydrive AM32 60A 3-6S
Category: ESCs
Status: Available
URL: https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/skydrive-am32-60a.html

The Skydrive AM32 60A is a 3-6S electronic speed controller running open AM32 firmware, so you can configure and update it with the usual AM32 tools. Its 60 A rating suits heavy-lift and agriculture drones carrying sprayer payloads.

Highlights:
- 60 A rating for heavy payloads
- AM32 firmware, configurable with standard AM32 tools
- 3-6S LiPo input

Specifications:
- Current: 60 A
- Battery: 3-6S
- Firmware: AM32

## NAVSATE GPS for UAVs
Category: GPS
Status: Available
URL: https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/navsate-gps-for-uavs.html

NAVSATE is our GPS module tuned for UAVs and tested on long flights. It gives your flight controller the position and ground-speed data it needs for position hold, return-to-home and waypoint missions, and pairs with Aazmuth for survey, agriculture and defence work.

Highlights:
- Tuned for UAVs
- Tested on long flights
- Enables position hold, return-to-home and waypoint missions

Specifications:
- Built for: UAVs
- Use: Position hold, return-to-home, waypoints

## ELRS FPV radio receiver
Category: Receivers
Status: Available
URL: https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/elrs-fpv-receiver.html

The ELRS receiver is an ExpressLRS-approved 2.4 GHz receiver for FPV aircraft. It uses an ESP32 microcontroller with a Semtech RF chip and a built-in TCXO, and connects to the flight controller over the CRSF bus. It gives a fast, smooth link with telemetry back to the radio.

Highlights:
- ESP32 microcontroller
- ExpressLRS-approved design
- Fast and smooth connection
- Built-in TCXO
- CRSF bus interface

Specifications:
- Microcontroller: ESP32
- RF chip: Semtech
- Frequency: 2.4 GHz
- Interface: CRSF bus
- Antenna: 65 mm 2.4 GHz T-antenna
- Telemetry RF power: 10 mW
- Input voltage: 5 V

## 4-in-1 ESC 80A 3-6S
Category: ESCs
Status: Available
URL: https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/sate-4-in-1-esc-80a.html

The 4-in-1 ESC puts four motor-drive channels on a single board for FPV quadcopters and multirotors. It runs AM32 firmware, supports DShot with bidirectional control, and includes crash protection plus reverse-voltage and short-circuit protection. Catalogue rating is 80 A continuous.

Highlights:
- DShot protocol support
- Bidirectional control
- Crash-protection feature
- Reverse-voltage and short-circuit protection
- AM32 firmware supported
- Wide compatibility and customization

Specifications:
- Current: 80 A continuous (as stated in catalogue)
- Battery: 3-6S
- Type: 4-in-1
- Firmware: AM32
- Microcontroller: STM
- MOSFETs: High-capacity

## Aazmuth Mini
Category: Flight controllers
Status: Coming soon
URL: https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/aazmuth-mini.html

Aazmuth Mini is a compact, budget-friendly flight controller for training drones. It uses an STM32H7 with fourth-generation InvenSense inertial sensing, a MEAS barometer and an industry-grade magnetometer, inside a low-profile case designed to minimise airflow disturbance in flight.

Highlights:
- Cost-effective design with low-profile form factor
- Budget-friendly solution
- External casing designed to minimize airflow disturbance

Specifications:
- Microcontroller: STM32H7
- IMU: InvenSense 4th-generation gyroscope and accelerometer
- Barometer: MEAS high-precision
- Magnetometer: Industry-grade
- Power: High-efficiency power IC

## SATE-AIO Board
Category: Flight controllers
Status: Available
URL: https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/sate-aio-board.html

SATE-AIO is an all-in-one board that combines an STM32 flight controller, a 4th-generation IMU, an industrial-grade barometer and an integrated 4-in-1 ESC rated up to 25 A continuous. It is AM32 compatible with DShot support, for compact FPV and multirotor builds.

Highlights:
- STM32 microcontroller for fast, low-latency flight control
- Single 4th-generation IMU for stability and noise rejection
- Industrial-grade barometer for altitude sensing
- Integrated 4-in-1 ESC and power system
- AM32 compatible with DShot protocol support

Specifications:
- Microcontroller: STM32
- IMU: 4th-generation, single
- Barometer: Industrial-grade
- ESC: Integrated 4-in-1, up to 25 A continuous
- Firmware: AM32 compatible
- Protocol: DShot

## SATE FalconEye PLFM radar
Category: Radar
Status: Coming soon
URL: https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/sate-falconeye-plfm.html

SATE FalconEye PLFM is a modular electronic beam-steering radar platform, currently under development. It comes in two versions: AERIS-10N (Nexus) with a 3 km range and an 8 x 16 patch antenna array, and AERIS-10E (Extended) with a 20 km range and a 32 x 16 dielectric-filled slotted waveguide array. Beam steering covers plus or minus 45 degrees in elevation and azimuth. An onboard FPGA handles pulse compression, Doppler FFT, MTI and CFAR, and a Python GUI with map integration and GPS/IMU position and attitude correction ties it together.

Highlights:
- Two versions: AERIS-10N (Nexus) and AERIS-10E (Extended)
- Full electronic beam steering, plus or minus 45 degrees in elevation and azimuth
- Onboard FPGA for pulse compression, Doppler FFT, MTI and CFAR
- Python GUI with map integration
- GPS/IMU integration for real-time position and attitude correction
- Modular power-management, frequency-synthesis and RF boards

Specifications:
- AERIS-10N (Nexus): 3 km range, 8 x 16 patch antenna array
- AERIS-10E (Extended): 20 km range, 32 x 16 dielectric-filled slotted waveguide array
- Beam steering: Plus or minus 45 degrees, elevation and azimuth
- Signal processing: Pulse compression, Doppler FFT, MTI, CFAR

## Kinetik Flight Controller
Category: Flight controllers
Status: Available
URL: https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/kinetik-flight-controller.html

Kinetik FC is a compact, FPV-based flight controller designed for drone enthusiasts, developers, and UAV builders. Measuring just 5 × 5 cm, it supports both Betaflight and ArduPilot, offering the flexibility to power everything from FPV freestyle and racing drones to autonomous UAVs. Its standout feature is dual firmware compatibility, giving users the freedom to choose between high-performance FPV flying and advanced autonomous flight on a single platform.

Highlights:
- ArduPilot and Betaflight supported

Specifications:
- Voltage: 3S to 6S
- Microcontroller: STM32 H7
- Redundancy: 2 IMUs, 2 barometers


## Frequently asked questions
Q: What is AM32 firmware?
A: AM32 is open-source firmware for 32-bit brushless ESCs. Skydrive ESCs run it, so you can configure and update them with the usual AM32 tools.

Q: Which ESC should I buy for an agriculture or sprayer drone?
A: Start with the Skydrive AM32 60A 3-6S, which is meant for heavier payloads. Share your motor, prop and battery setup and we will confirm the fit.

Q: Which flight controller should I pick?
A: Aazmuth for redundancy and professional work, Exelr8 F7 for FPV builds. Tell us your build and we will confirm.

Q: Are your drone electronics made in India?
A: They are designed in India by our own hardware and firmware engineers, so support and fixes are a phone call away.

Q: Can I buy in bulk or for a company or OEM project?
A: Yes. Send quantity and use case through the quote form, or call or WhatsApp us, and we will reply with the right parts.

Q: Where are the pinouts and setup guides?
A: In our public documentation. Each product page links to its own docs, where they exist.

Q: Do you ship across India?
A: Call or WhatsApp us with your pincode and quantity and we will confirm shipping.

Q: When will the coming-soon products launch?
A: The TRX transmitters are on our roadmap. Message us and we will tell you as soon as there is a date.
